summary.name: Genve.ai
summary.one_liner: Genve.ai is an AI video translator that dubs and lip-syncs videos into 140+ languages using voice cloning.
use_cases: dub YouTube videos into other languages
localize product demos and ads for e-commerce
translate training videos for global employees
reach non-English viewers on TikTok and Instagram
clone your voice for multi-language content
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI system that translates and dubs video into 140+ languages with AI lip-sync and voice cloning intended to keep the speaker's original voice, intonation and emotional tone. It mentions a custom lexicon for brand-specific terms and automatic currency and measurement detection in speech. Stated workflows include uploading a video once for distribution across channels and processing multiple files. Plan details list AI translation minute allowances, HD and 4K output, and credit rollover. The page itself is mostly marketing, and it offers no technical detail on how the translation works.
notable: Voice cloning that aims to preserve the original speaker's tone across 30+ or 140+ languages
AI lip-sync included in all listed plans
Custom lexicon support for brand-specific terms
Plans offer 1080P, 4K Ultra HD resolution and no watermark on paid tiers
caveats: Paid tiers are billed per month with annual billing; the exact prices are not shown in the page text
Usage is limited by credits and translation minutes per year (360, 1440 or 4320 on listed plans)
Page claims such as 300% CTR increase and 90% faster turnaround are marketing statements, not independently verified
